To me, Mother is
the Tiara Umamusume I respect more than anyone.

The words slip out before I realize it, and I suddenly startle.
...The scene from the mock race the other day flashes back into my mind.

Air Messiah smiles proudly.
The moment I saw her profile—

She isn't... getting shaken off?! Amazing!
Messiah is still clinging onto Cesario—!
—That is precisely why. I am glad that this is the 'me' I am.

*pant*, *gasp*... But.
Last time, it was a one-length margin. This time—she closed in to a neck.

I find myself murmuring those words from the bottom of my heart.
Air Messiah. She truly is, through and through—
HAAAAAAAAAH...!!

...Five-minute break.
I still have... 15 km left for the morning run...!
My mind was made up.
Five more sets... of planks...!

Supported by a thoroughly trained core, her form was polished to perfection.
It channeled the flow of power coursing through her entire body properly—

There was nothing I could say.
All I could do was gaze at her eyes, shining with dignified and resolute determination.

Apply what you learned from last time and do your best to show the results of your training.
Now then, first group, to your starting positions!

Throughout the rest of the summer camp, whenever there was time for independent
training, I often saw Air Messiah devoting herself to core strengthening. ...Over and over again.

She said it was nearby... but it kept pouring heavily after that yesterday.
I doubt it was the kind of trouble that could be brushed off with just 'I felt bad'—

Being your daughter is my...
pride, my blessing, and my salvation.

Yet, precisely because of that—
—I can push forward toward glory, step by steady, solid step.

Steadily, reliably, one step forward at a time.
From a neck to a head. From a head to a nose.

Phew, that's it for today!
Ah, thank you for your hard work too, Trainer!
—I swear upon this blood, I surely will.
Diligent, you say? ...Yes, indeed.

That is the 'strength' I inherited.
That is the 'pride' I was given.
And someday, I will surely stand before you.

To prove that Mother was never merely an 'almost-there' Umamusume.
To prove the sheer greatness of what has been passed down and inherited.
...Indeed.
Here, please accept this.
Providing a solid foundation to triumph over the strong.

It is not outstanding. Nor is it extraordinary.
It is unflashy, honest, and earnest.
From Mother, whom I love and revere more than anyone.

Afterward, I checked another store with stock, and fortunately it was nearby...
I felt bad simply taking yours for myself.

Not yet... Not yet...!
Aaahhhhhhhh!!

The following evening. Seeing off the Umamusume as they headed
back to the lodging after training, I stood there feeling somewhat unsettled.

I will run through the Twinkle Series,
and—I will claim victory in the Triple Tiara races.

The final day of summer camp, the concluding mock race.
Facing off once again, Air Messiah and Cesario—
turned into a one-on-one duel in the final stretch, just like last time.

That is my merit—
In fact, one could say it is 'my only merit.'
And single-mindedly—

The late-summer breeze blew by.
The beginning of destiny carried the fresh scent of green.

She worked diligently and earnestly, yet was still defeated by an overwhelming presence.
To someone like her, calling it 'her only merit' must surely—

Therefore, I will achieve victory.
Making the diligence and reliability inherited from my mother my greatest strengths.

*gasp*...! *pant*, *pant*...
—It is my defeat once again, isn't it? Splendidly done.

Checking the contents of the paper bag from Air Messiah... I was astonished.
It was the exact same book I had given up to her at the bookstore yesterday.

One, two, three... One, two, three, four, five...!
One, two, three... One, two, three, four, five...!

And so, Air Messiah spoke with her usual composure.
...Which gave her words an overwhelming sense of certainty.

Mother. ...With just that—
my chest fills with the strength to keep moving forward.

*huff*, *huff*, *huff*, ...nghhhh!!
...—*pant*, *pant*, *pant*.

All right, gather up! Now, as the final touch to summer camp,
we'll hold another mock race. The groups will be the same as last time!
Ah... Apologies for keeping you waiting, Trainer.
*gasp*...! *pant*, *pant*, *pant*.
